01 — The Context

What institutions typically face.

Educational institutions modernizing operations need one system for students, staff, finance, and academics. Admissions, attendance, fees, and results often sit in separate records, and administrators, teachers, and parents each need a reliable view of them.

Alongside the system, institutions need a plan for teaching AI responsibly: a structured program for staff and students, not a one-off session.
